title: Specora Attestation Manifest v1.0
description: Normative JSON Schema for the attestation-manifest canonical payload, Specora Wire Spec v1.0 §2.2.

id.description: Lowercase UUID v4 identifier for this snapshot.

org_id.description: Lowercase UUID v4 identifying the producing organization.

snapshot_type.description: v1.0 permits only the 'window' snapshot type.

period_start.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with mandatory Z suffix and no fractional seconds.
